verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਫੇਰਿ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਗਾਇ ਜਿਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kalajug naamaa bhagat hoi fer dhehuraa gai jivaiee|

en.bdb: In kaliyuga, a devotee named Namdev made the temple rotate and dead cow alive.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨੇ ਤੇ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat kabeer vakhaaneeaai ba(n)dheekhaane te uTh jaiee|

en.bdb: It is said Kabir used to go out of prison as and when he liked.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਧਨਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕਸਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)naa jaT udhaariaa sadhanaa jaat ajaat kasaiee|

en.bdb: Dhanna, the jatt (farmer) and Sadhana born in a known low cast butcher got across the world ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: jan ravidhaas chamaar hoi chahu varanaa vich kar vaddiaaiee|

en.bdb: Considering Ravi Das a devotee of the Lord, all the four varnas praise him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਣਿ ਹੋਆ ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਸੈਣੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ben hoaa adhiaatamee sain neech kul a(n)dhar naiee|

en.bdb: Beni, the saint was a spiritualist, and born in a so-called low barber caste Sain was a devotee (of Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paa khaak hoi gursikhaa(n) vich vaddee samaiee|

en.bdb: Falling at and becoming the dust of the feet is the great trance for the Sikhs of the Guru (their caste should not be considered).
The devotees, though they behold the imperceptible Lord, yet do not disclose this to anyone.
